violet: FYI I found a reproducible class of funcall parse failures on the zephyr-int4 canary: JSON ends cleanly but the stream has a short trailing suffix (non-utf8 or utf16 fragments) and our parser throws. ~3% structured calls.

sam: can you paste a raw capture?

violet: example (raw):
```
{"tool":"search","args":["redwood inference guides"]}\x66\x00\x74\x00
```

obra: interesting, that looks like utf16-le bytes after the JSON. any correlates?

violet: strong signal with kvcache enabled + batch_size >= 12. single-request flows are almost clean.

maria: short-term we can try three postproc arms on canary behind flags: 1) sanitizer: strip trailing invalid utf8, attempt NDJSON last-object parse + 1 retry 2) sentinel: append per-request random-salted anchor `<<END:crc32:BASE64:rand12>>` and validate 3) utf16-strip: detect valid utf16-le tail and convert/strip.

sam: metrics to emit: schema_compliance, parse_fallback_used, parse_error_class (invalid_utf8|utf16_tail|trailing_bytes), sanitizer_trim_bytes_hist, sentinel_collision_count, p95/p99 latency. 2k samples per arm should show signal.

obra: implementation notes: keep all behaviors behind `postproc.*` runtime flags and tag telemetry with model=zephyr-int4, quant=int4, batch_size, kvcache_hit, arm. make sentinel use per-request 12-byte salt to avoid accidental collisions.

maria: quick parser fallback idea: try json.loads; on failure try s.encode('utf-8','ignore').decode('utf-8') then parse; then NDJSON last-object; and emit which fallback succeeded. this recovers many cases but we must track latency cost.

violet: longer term: instrument post-decode raw token bytes on failures (PII-safe) and run mirror path through fp16 model to confirm whether quant decode or kvcache rotation emits the extra bytes. filing INF-10180.

sam: if sentinel lowers failure rate with no collisions, we can roll to dedicated for a week before the runtime fix. but file bug for runtime memcpy/encode suspicion.

canary-bot: canary update: zephyr-int4 at 5% traffic. rolling schema_fail (30m): 3.0%.

maria: I'll run eval (2k/arm) tonight and post a mini-notebook with schema pass rates, retry success, and latency histograms. tagging obra for postproc flags.

obra: adding parse_fallback_detail and utf16_strip_bytes to runtime metrics. will push small PR for postproc toggles in `serving/postproc/parse_guards.py`.

violet: thanks all  keeping logs and example captures in INF-10180. will post results in-thread when evals finish.
